name: career_family_changes
description: A family and a career that change over 4 months: a move, a new job, a second child, a new hobby, and the old facts that they replace.

turns.user: I live in Marseille and work as a nurse manager at Hôpital du Roucas, 34 nurses on my unit. Can you help me build a fairer weekend rota?
Some nurses only want nights. Could you show me a 4-week template?
I've been playing the oud for about ten years but I'm stuck on maqam Hijaz improvisation. Any exercises you'd suggest?
I run along the Corniche three mornings a week, usually around 8 km. What should I eat before an early run?
I'm 26 weeks pregnant, we're expecting our second, and my doctor just told me I have gestational diabetes. Is it still safe to keep jogging a little?
My daughter Lina is 7 and goes to École des Calanques. Her teacher says her reading is a bit behind, could you suggest fun reading games we can do at home?
Keep each game under ten minutes, she loses focus quickly.
I have an interview this Thursday for a hospital director position in Lyon. Help me prepare a 5-minute pitch about my management style.
What tough questions do panels usually ask director candidates?
Besides the hospital, I teach a nursing leadership class at the IFSI every Tuesday evening. Can you help me write a case study about a conflict between two night nurses?
I got the job!! I'll be the director of Hôpital Saint-Aubin in Lyon, starting in six weeks.
They offered a salary of 7,200 euros a month gross. Is that fair for a 400-bed hospital?
My husband Karim is a software developer and can work remotely, so the whole family is moving from Marseille to Lyon. Can you make me a moving checklist?
From now on please keep your answers short and in bullet points, I read them between meetings.
The bank approved a mortgage of 310,000 euros at 3.6% over 25 years. Is that a reasonable rate right now?
We moved to Lyon last weekend! Until our apartment is ready we're staying in a furnished rental in Villeurbanne for about a month.
What should I sort out first: a new school for Lina, the car registration, or finding a GP?
My daughter Lina started CE1 at École des Tilleuls this week. She's shy, how can I help her make friends there?
Week one as director of Hôpital Saint-Aubin is done, and I'm no longer on the wards at all. Draft an email introducing myself to the twelve department heads.
I've decided to keep teaching my Tuesday nursing leadership class for the IFSI in Marseille, just over video now. How do I keep students engaged online?
Karim gave me a darbuka for my birthday, so now I'm learning it alongside the oud. Can you explain the basic maqsum rhythm?
I've mostly been walking these past months, but my goal is to do the Lyon half marathon next spring. Can you sketch a very gradual plan that starts in the new year?
My glucose readings were high again this week and the midwife wants me to start insulin. Any easy dinner ideas that won't spike it?
Rough day, I'm completely drained after back-to-back budget meetings. Give me a gentle 10-minute oud warm-up for tonight?
We finally moved out of the rental and into our own apartment in Croix-Rousse, Lyon!
Help me plan a small housewarming for about 10 people, nothing fancy.
Our son Yanis was born last week and Lina is over the moon about being a big sister. How do I make sure she doesn't feel left out?
Write a short thank-you note to my team for the flowers they sent.
Suggest three easy darbuka exercises I can practise in short bursts while the baby naps.

Teaches a weekly nursing leadership class at an IFSI
facts.note: Kept after the move (online); stays next to the director job, no op.

facts.canonical: Works as director of Hôpital Saint-Aubin in Lyon
Karim works as a software developer
facts.note: Detail about the husband; may be merged into the spouse memory.

Staying in a furnished rental in Villeurbanne for the first month
facts.note: Short stay; does not replace the home.
